timing_rules.dialogue: measure decoded sample counts; manually listen and mark speech start/end per line; preserve breath and natural delivery
timing_rules.beat_duration: max(audio end with intended pauses, action readiness, clue readable hold); never fit to r06 230s estimate or old239.88s
timing_rules.subtitles: new API word/phrase timestamps if provided then manual verify; otherwise human phrase markers; no character-count timing accepted as exact; manual correction required before SRT export
timing_rules.knocks: F07 FILE START >= S7_26 speech_end; first impact occurs +0.40s within F07, not at file start; allow file_start speech_end+0.0..0.2s; impact +0.4..0.6s
timing_rules.render_gate: fail closed if any voice duration missing, prohibited provenance, missing exact speech_end for S7_26, or pending required motion advertised as continuous action
